complexDefinition.stringValue: To carry, convey, conduct, or cause something to come with, to, or toward the speaker.

definition.stringValue: To carry something or someone to a place.

text.stringValue: Перенести что-то или кого-то в какое-то место.
**Bring** the laptop to the meeting room.
Did you **bring** your lunch today?
I'll **bring** my friend to the party.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To cause or prompt (someone or something) to start doing, being, or acting in a certain way.

definition.stringValue: To cause someone or something to start acting a certain way.

text.stringValue: Заставить кого-то или что-то начать действовать определенным образом.
**Bring** your focus back to the task at hand.
The victory will **bring** confidence to our team.
Mediating between the two parties will **bring** peace.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To cause to appear or occur in the mind or emotions.

definition.stringValue: To make feelings or thoughts appear.

text.stringValue: Создавать ощущения или мысли.
**Bring** up past memories always make me nostalgic.
Whenever I hear that song, it **brings** back happy thoughts.
His words **bring** feelings of hope and determination.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To cause to come to or toward a specified place; attract.

definition.stringValue: To attract someone or something to a place.

text.stringValue: Привлечь кого-то или что-то в определенное место.
**Bring** all your friends to the party tonight.
Her charisma **brings** a crowd wherever she goes.
This event will **bring** many tourists to our town.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To lead or guide to a particular place or in a particular direction.

definition.stringValue: To guide someone or something to a place or direction.

text.stringValue: Направлять кого-то или что-то в определенное место или направление.
**Bring** the children to the park, please.
He gently **brought** her back to reality.
Can you **bring** the car around to the front?

complexDefinition.stringValue: To raise (a question, issue) for consideration or discussion.

definition.stringValue: To bring up a topic for discussion or consideration.

text.stringValue: Поднести тему для обсуждения или рассмотрения.
**Bring** up your concerns in the next meeting.
I'll **bring** this matter up with the supervisor.
Do not forget to **bring** your ideas to the table.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To fetch, get, take, give, or put in a particular place or position.

definition.stringValue: To place something in a certain position.

text.stringValue: Разместить что-то в определенном положении.
**Bring** the chairs closer to the table.
Could you please **bring** your feet off the table?
Remember to **bring** your hands to your heart in prayer.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To cause or enable (something or someone) to be in a particular condition or state.

definition.stringValue: To make someone or something be in a certain state or condition.

text.stringValue: Заставить кого-то или что-то находиться в определенном состоянии или условии.
**Bring** the room to complete silence.
Your kindness will **bring** tears to her eyes.
His failure will **bring** humiliation to him.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To cause or make happen (an action or a state of affairs).

definition.stringValue: To cause a specific action to happen.

text.stringValue: Вызвать определенное действие.
**Bring** about a change in company policy.
His hardwork will **bring** success.
The advertisement will **bring** in more customers.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To cause or compel (someone or something) to come with the speaker or to the place or recipient denoted by context.

definition.stringValue: To compel someone or something to come with you.

text.stringValue: Вынудить кого-то или что-то идти с вами.
**Bring** your brother to the party tonight.
She was forced to **bring** the documents to court.
Make sure you **bring** your ID to the check-in counter.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To bring an action against, to go to law about.

definition.stringValue: To take legal action against someone.

text.stringValue: Предпринять юридические действия против кого-то.
**Bring** charges against the corrupt official.
The victim decided to **bring** a lawsuit.
The state will **bring** a case against the fraudulent company.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To bring to bed, of a woman in labour.

definition.stringValue: Used to refer to a woman giving birth.

text.stringValue: Используется для обозначения женщины, рожающей ребенка.
**Bring** your child into the world with love.
She hopes to **bring** twins into existence.
Grace decided to **bring** life into the world.
Рвать или блевать.
**Bring** up last night's dinner wasn't part of the plan.
The rollercoaster ride made him **bring** up his lunch instantly.
The stomach flu caused him to constantly **bring** up food.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To create, evoke or provide (a feeling, response, or condition).

definition.stringValue: To make a feeling, response, or condition happen.

text.stringValue: Вызывать чувство, реакцию или состояние.
**Bring** peace to your mind through meditation.
His spiteful words **bring** only anger and resentment.
Seeing her again **bring** the old feelings of love back.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To bring about a specific result or effect.

text.stringValue: Вызвать определенный результат.
**Bring** can often cause excitement among children.
Negligence can **bring** about serious consequences.
Hard work will **bring** success.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To summon or call forth (evidence, a response, etc.).

definition.stringValue: To call for evidence or a response.

text.stringValue: Требовать представить доказательства или ответ.
**Bring** proof to support your argument.
I must **bring** this matter to my lawyer's attention.
Can you **bring** any witnesses to corroborate your story?

complexDefinition.stringValue: To bring forward, allude to, introduce (a topic, idea, etc.).

text.stringValue: Представить тему.
**Bring** up the subject of dinner plans tonight.
Did you **bring** up the new project proposal in the meeting?
She always manages to **bring** the conversation back to gardening.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To draw or direct (attention, a person's gaze, etc.) towards something.

text.stringValue: Направить внимание на что-то.
**Bring** your focus to the task at hand.
Please **bring** everyone's attention to these figures.
Let's **bring** discussion back to budget concerns.

complexDefinition.stringValue: To bear or conduct oneself in a certain manner.

definition.stringValue: To behave in a certain manner.

text.stringValue: Вести себя определенным образом.
**Bring** your best effort to the competition.
He always **brings** positivity to our conversations.
You shouldn't **bring** negativity into this loving environment.
